entries.ja: イディルシャイアのハーフシクスは、点検作業が進められずに困っている。

entries.en: It seems the Idyllshire aetheryte may be growing unstable, and is in need of a proper inspection. However, Halfsix lacks the necessary aetherflow distributors to make his analysis. As with many things in the burgeoning settlement, it appears these, too, are located somewhere within the Arkhitekton. Thus, Halfsix bids that you make your way there and search the Illuminati pots for three of these tools.

entries.en: Uplanders of Sharlayan are making aetherytes to whirl, using tricksy ancient knowings. If gobbieflock uses tools and parts left by old uplanders, then aetheryte of Idyllshire will stay spinning for many, many years!
entries.fr: Les éthérites ont été fabriquées grâce à une technologie ancienne. Ce sont les Sharlayanais qui ont trouvé la technique et qui ont créé les premières. Du coup, elles marchent mieux quand on les répare en recyclant des vieilles pièces !
entries.ja:
エーテライトは　古代の知識の応用技術～！
シャーレアン人　解明し　大工房で　作ってた～！
古い部品を　再利用　そうすりゃ　自前で維持できる～！
